name: – Anna Strolenberg – After § 67 – Am 57
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 67a. Expresses grave concern that the fundamental right to freedom of expression is increasingly being eroded under the guise of combating disinformation and alleged harmful content, leading to censorship and the silencing of legitimate public debate; stresses that in a true democracy, citizens must be free to express dissenting, controversial or unpopular views without fear of suppression or reprisal; recalls that freedom of speech is not a privilege granted by authorities, but a core right that must be robustly defended;
